comment: Per-project autonomy policy. Copied into .claude/autonomy.json to tune what hooks auto-fix vs. queue vs. PR. Defaults are conservative. Most-specific path pattern wins; globals are fallback.

paths.comment: Per-domain thresholds. auto_apply=minimum confidence to ship without review. open_pr=minimum confidence to open a PR (below that, queue for Claude).

model_source_allowed_comment: Model sources this repo may send code to (scripts/model-source.sh names: claude, claude-local, claude-cloud-<name>; * globs). ["*"] or absent = all. Client-data repos: ["claude-local"].

stop_processor.comment: Remediation-queue processor at Stop (hooks/stop-queue-processor.sh). On by default since round 2 step 8; false here or gates.stop_processor false turns it off.

snapshots.comment: Stateful-data snapshots before risky commands (checks/pretooluse-snapshot.sh, A5 2026-07-23). Opt-in: disabled by default. paths are relative to project root; empty trigger_patterns falls back to a built-in migration/infra-apply list.

deploy.comment: Post-deploy smoke targets for checks/deploy-verify.sh (audit 6.9/6.10). Deploy subset of the R13 done-block; warn-first. Remove this comment and fill in real targets per project. rollback_command is optional (A6, 2026-07-23): if set, deploy-verify.sh runs it once per session when the post-deploy smoke check fails. Mitigation only; the check still blocks.

contract.comment: Standing answers from /warp's autonomy-contract step (2026-08-27). null = ask at the next warp; set = every later session inherits it without re-asking. Enums: merge_on_done_contract peter_only|claude_after_done_contract|ask_each_time; deploy_in_session never|additive_migrations_only|full; login_mode once_per_session|ask_each_login|none; ui_reference_policy mock_first|proposal_deck_mid_run|case_by_case. plan_path/unit_name/ui_reference_path/live_proof/external_systems/visible_surface_globs are per-project facts contract-scan.mjs reads; standing_rules holds Peter's free-text answers verbatim. W1 (Peter 2026-09-24, "just have it work and only stop if critical"): the switch values here are the GLOBAL standing answers; a repo that leaves a switch null, or writes a value outside its enum, reads the value here (hooks/lib/effective-contract.sh, gates.global_standing_answers), and a repo value in the enum wins. sdk_updates patch_security_auto|ask_each_time: a patch or security SDK update goes live on a client site once that site's tests and preview pass; anything bigger waits for Peter. stop_conditions and the two standing_rules are promoted from flux (plan-round3 F1).
stop_conditions: a change would touch a real (non-test) record: test data only, named with the project test prefix (flux: ZZTEST)
an action would spend money or change billing
a destructive migration or deleting data is needed
the work needs a scope change
standing_rules: One adversarial refuter re-reads the evidence behind every QA PASS before a merge.
Merged, unproven is not complete: done = merged AND the proof path AND the refuter report.

model_profiles.comment: Optional. Per-model policy knobs, keyed by any name you choose. Resolved once per session by hooks/lib/profile.sh into session-env/<sid>/profile.json. With gates.capability_probe on, a profile that declares `requires` ({tool_json, instruction, min_context_window}) is chosen by a SessionStart probe of the active source's endpoint (lib/capability-probe.sh): the least strict profile the model qualifies for wins; a failed probe or no qualifying profile means the strictest profile. `match` (list of name substrings) is optional and only used when no probe result exists, e.g. the probe is off or the source has no key; kept here so a session that cannot be probed resolves as it did before. subagent_model is the only model a subagent may be launched on (checks/subagent-model-guard.sh); unset means the CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL default. context_window_tokens and canary.{advisory,wrapup,hard}_pct override the probe and the window-derived canary. exemplar_injection is read by hooks/exemplar-inject.sh. review_tier_floor is the minimum reviewer tier (config/reviewers.json). mcp_servers (task_type -> project .mcp.json server names, "default" for the rest) is applied by hooks/lib/mcp-trim.sh at SessionStart; a profile without it (frontier) is left untouched. max_concurrent_subagents is written to the session profile.json. handoff "deterministic" (round 2 step 8): at the canary hard tier the harness writes .claude/handoff.md from plan state, changed files, receipts and last blocks, so the model never summarises its own state. max_sessions_per_source: the rail refuses a new row on this source past the cap (1 is a conservative placeholder: the step 0 concurrency measurement was deferred with the box). loop_budget (plan-round3 L0c): an autonomous session parks its unit after this many Stop blocks of any kind, so bouncing between different checks also ends; falls back to gates.loop_budget, default 8; 0 = off.
